nodes.description: Public pure function getLabel(uint256 slot) that returns a color name string from a fixed 24-element in-memory array, indexed by slot % names.length.
Public pure function getData(uint256 slot) that returns ABI-packed SVG rect bytes built from a fixed 24-element in-memory color array, indexed by slot % colors.length.
uint256 slot parameter of getLabel, used only as a modulo index into the local names array.
In-memory string[24] names array holding 24 hardcoded color names, indexed and returned by getLabel.
uint256 slot parameter of getData, used only as a modulo index into the local colors array.
In-memory string[24] colors array holding 24 hardcoded hex color strings, indexed and ABI-encoded by getData.

edges.reason: The slot parameter flows into getLabel where it is reduced modulo names.length and used as an array index to select the returned color name.
The local names array is read by getLabel and its element is returned to the caller.
The slot parameter flows into getData where it is reduced modulo colors.length and used as an array index to select a color string.
The local colors array element is read by getData and concatenated into the returned abi.encodePacked bytes.

normalization_plan.reason: The slot parameter is a non-core input used solely to index the names array inside getLabel, so it should be normalized into the getLabel function node.
The names local array is purely internal to getLabel and has no independent security identity, so it merges into the getLabel function node.
The slot parameter is a non-core input used solely to index the colors array inside getData, so it should be normalized into the getData function node.
The colors local array is purely internal to getData and has no independent security identity, so it merges into the getData function node.
